description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Cadaver Imp.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Cadaver Imp that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Cadaver Imp token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

uses.name: Empowered Autogenerator
uses.cardState: with two or more charge counters on it
